ios.desc:
Meet Terry, the llama who walks with you.

Terry counts your steps and changes with you. Walk more and he goes from very round to fit. Take it easy for a few days and he gets a little round again. No guilt, just a fluffy llama cheering you on.

EVERY STEP COUNTS
• A daily step goal made for you, with a ring that fills as you walk
• Hourly activity, so you see when you move the most
• Streaks that keep you coming back
• Gentle reminders at the time that suits you

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Your week at a glance: steps, walking time and pace
• When you walk best, your personal records and your best days
• Notes and photos from your walks

TERRY+
• Your whole story: Month, Year and All-time views
• Compare steps, walking time and pace with last month and last year
• Every day you have walked, not just the last 3
• Streak shields, up to 4 photos per note and exclusive app icons

TERRY+ PLANS
• Terry+ Monthly: renews every month
• Terry+ Yearly: renews every year, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
• Terry+ Lifetime: a one-time purchase that never renews
Prices are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country or region.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://walkwithterry.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://walkwithterry.web.app/privacy
